Dear [Mr Macmillan](/person/939)
I have to thank you for sending me the parcel of German books, which I hope will much add to the correctness of my [story](/book/62). I am not sure however that one has not come for me to which I have no right -Alt-Nordisches Leben Von Dr Karl Weinhold -
[Miss Keary](/person/793) told me that you had promised to get for her some Old Northern books, so perhaps it was meant for her.

In that case shall I send it?

Did you also put in Duncan’s Shipwrecks which do indeed look like a store of Golden Deeds -?

Any way I am very glad of the freight, and much obliged to you for putting me in the way of getting these books.

Will you be kind enough to have a copy of [Golden Deeds](/book/51) sent to
	Mlle [Marianne von Nathusius](/person/1077),
Meyendorf
Leckhausen
Magdeburg.

She wants to get the start in translating it, before [Tauchnitz](/person/1396)’s English edition comes out. [Mme de Witt ](/person/423)is translating it into French

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
Please to let sheets of the [Clever Woman](/book/58) go to M.

Tauchnitz, unless this has been already done. I have heard from him today about it
